formal_gate: Do not run an unconditional large service matrix. Require no compiled behavioral changes and evidence of legal coverage improvement or a material critical-path cost reduction. Freeze any subsequent selection/arrival/SLO/arms before formal output.
candidate_choice_rule: At least 2/2 development sources for a model/family must satisfy all original scope/output/raw-candidate-EOS margins and exact observed free-generation behavior. Prefer most stable full blocks, then lower measured complete verification cost; never online multi-level descent. A formerly L0 family also needs a separate defensible cost calibration before serving; feasibility alone is not deployment qualification.
